title: Cosmic Dream Collage
description: A vibrant surreal collage divided into distinct sections. Top half features a lush flower meadow with colorful daisies and cosmos, a small silhouetted figure on a cliff, a glowing crystal ball containing a blue gem and a person, and a large close-up portrait of a woman's face with blue eyes. Bottom half shows a white cat inside a swirling colorful galaxy with planets, a red-haired woman with green eyes, and a green alien skull with red eyes inside a mechanical red orb with orbiting spheres.
